overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies black pepper powder for B2B buyers who need consistent quality for manufacturing, foodservice, and private label supply. The product is made from carefully selected black peppercorns, then cleaned, ground, and sieved under controlled food-processing conditions. This helps deliver a uniform powder for repeatable blending, dosing, and packing requirements.

We support bulk supply, OEM and private label programs, custom mesh and packaging requests, and sample approval before final order placement. As an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter from India, we handle export documentation support and commercial supply coordination. Our process covers sourcing, cleaning, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for black pepper powder?
faqs.a: The MOQ is 5 kg. We can discuss larger bulk requirements based on your packing and specification needs.

faqs.q: Can you supply private label black pepper powder?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM and private label supply, including small pouches, jars, and custom printed packaging on request.

faqs.q: What mesh size do you offer?
faqs.a: The standard specification is 80–100 mesh. We can review custom mesh requirements on request.
We follow a 6-step process: sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you provide samples and export documents?
faqs.a: Yes. Samples are available on request. We also provide export documentation support as part of the supply process.

faqs.q: How should black pepper powder be stored?
faqs.a: Store it in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture. Keep the pack sealed after opening.
